newDialog.title: New purchase
newDialog.description: Pick a supplier and the receipt date to start. You can fill in the lines next.

importDialog.title: Import e-invoice
importDialog.description: Upload a supplier's e-invoice. It becomes a draft purchase you can check and approve.
importDialog.fileHint: UBL or CII XML (EN 16931), or a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF

warnings.vat_self_assessment_required: This is a reverse-charge invoice ({{category}}): the supplier charged no VAT, but you owe it and deduct it in the same return. The lines were booked at 0% — a purchase cannot record both sides, so settle this with your bookkeeper before approving.
warnings.possible_duplicate: A purchase with the same supplier, date and total already exists (#{{receipts}}). Check you are not entering this bill twice.
warnings.totals_mismatch: The lines do not add up to the {{stated}} the invoice states — they are off by {{amount}}. Correct the lines before approving.
warnings.line_missing_description: A line has no description. Fill it in before approving.
warnings.lines_synthesized_from_totals: The invoice states totals but no line detail (a Factur-X MINIMUM or BASIC WL document). One line was created carrying the full amount — add a description and expense account before approving.
warnings.buyer_is_not_this_tenant: The invoice is addressed to a different VAT or registration number than your band's. Check it is really yours before approving.
warnings.line_vat_rate_defaulted: A line stated no VAT rate; {{to}}% was applied.
warnings.vat_rate_adjusted: The {{from}}% rate is not a rate you can book; {{to}}% was applied instead.
warnings.document_discount_allocated: The invoice discount was spread across the lines — a purchase has no separate discount field.
warnings.document_charge_allocated: An invoice-level charge was spread across the lines — a purchase has no separate charge field.
warnings.prepaid_amount_ignored: The invoice records {{amount}} already prepaid. The full amount was booked; register the payment separately.
warnings.totals_rounded: Line amounts were adjusted by {{amount}} so the total matches the invoice.
warnings.supplier_not_matched: No matching supplier contact was found. The name was kept as text — link a contact in the draft.
warnings.attachment_skipped: The PDF embedded in the invoice could not be stored.

importDialog.alreadyImported: This invoice has already been recorded as purchase #{{receipts}}.

supplierFields.supplierInvoiceNumberHelp: The number the supplier put on the bill. Used to stop the same bill being entered twice.

payment.noBandMembers: Add a band member before registering a member-paid purchase.
payment.importedPaymentHelp: Optionally match an existing imported payment with the exact purchase amount.
payment.reclassifyHelp: The imported entry will be reclassified automatically. Its bank booking date is used.
payment.candidatesError: Imported payments could not be loaded. You can still register a new payment.

deleteDialog.title: Delete purchase?
deleteDialog.body: This permanently deletes the draft purchase. This cannot be undone.

validation.positiveAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero
validation.approvalIncomplete: Complete the highlighted purchase line fields before approving.
validation.accountingSetup: Choose an expense account for each line, or configure a default expense account in Accounting Settings.
validation.inactiveAccount: Replace the inactive account on line {{number}}
validation.bandMemberRequired: Choose the band member who paid for this purchase
